# weekdays 2018-01, all 24 hours
import datetime
days = []
d = datetime.date(2018,1,1)
while d.month==1 and d.year==2018:
    if d.weekday() < 5:
        if len(data.get(d.isoformat(), {}))==24:
            days.append(d)
    d += datetime.timedelta(days=1)

print("days:", [d.isoformat() for d in days])
sums = [sum(data[d.isoformat()].values()) for d in days]
print("per-day J:", sums)
print("mean:", sum(sums)/len(sums))
